name: obsidian-editor-uxfix
description: Long-press a line to fold or unfold it (its parent if it has no children); click where the caret is to toggle the line; Alt+wheel folds or unfolds the line under the mouse one level at a time (then its siblings, its parent, the parent's siblings and so on once nothing is left to change), Alt+Shift+wheel the whole document
author: Hyunyoung Park
